title: Zacs Basics
author: Ohrequiem
desc: This is as close as I can get to the program I would run if I was starting over again!!

ex.note: Using these as some preventative maintenance for shoulder health. Use the time between sets to also warm up with bands etc.
Every day is going to consist of one/two large compounds and then acces. work. Push these Bench sets pretty hard, looking for decent form here with a touch on the chest, not a bounce.
either Cable, pec deck, or dumbells. Whichever lets you get the most stretch without shoulder problems. Can push these past failure if desired!!!
Do less weight/bodyweight here. On push day #2 we'll be pushing it with heavy sets. Use this time to lock in the form for those sets later down the line.

ss.note: Take these as hard as you can!! these are a major builder and shouldn't be skipped!!!
These are a major arm builder, keep form acceptable without excessive elbow movement but don't be afraid to push it a little.

ex.note: Start lower than you think on these. If not weighted then do body weight, with a band if needed. The hardest part is the first pull up!!! (use straps if needed as you add more weight)
SPAM THESE, i put 4 sets but you can do more if desired. You're training a small group of upper back muscles here, they can recover fast. PUSH THESE HARD
Adjust seat so that the support is hitting just below your pec, this will allow the most scapular movement as possible. Let the weight pull your shoulders forward at the bottom. Use straps
Take these to failure!! First bicep isolation of the week, use that to put max effort in on these.
Start light with these and add weight later in the program. Really focusing on the lengthened/bottom position here. Can go past failure with lengthened partials but save till later in the program!
After Warm ups hit these harder than you think. 6-8 reps should be hard and heavy. Last two sets are there for skill work.
Keeping it lighter this day, later in the week we'll go heavier. Brace your core and push hips back, straps can help remove focus from grip.
We're doing these for our quads today, so keep feet closer together and low on the pad. Control the lowering on these.
These dont need much queing, just take them hard and lean forward for more stretch.

ss.note: Super set these with bodyweight sissy squats, i normally use the machine as a support.

ex.note: Use these similarly to the face pulls on the first push day, a glorified warm up. I use 15 lbs so start pretty light.
Now is the time to push these hard, load up the belt, put on the bumping tunes and bust out some heavy reps here. Warm up with a set of bodyweight here.
I prefer standing barbell over seated dumbell, whichever you feel more comfy taking to failure do.
Really Focus on feeling this in your triceps, your shoulders and chest should be rather fatigued already.

ss.note: These are one of my fav triceps builders! Keep elbows behind head, you can flare out if its more comfy for you or you can keep them forward.
This is something ive just started using and ive been loving it. Really focus on the bottom here, go heavier than normal and bust out partials.

ex.note: Take these as hard as possible; we limited lower back on the previous pull day just for these, make it count.
This will be our biggest quad movement today so push them hard and to failure. Feet close and low on pad. I want your calves touching your hamstrings. GET LOWER
Do these weighted with straps so your grip isn't a limiting factor. Knees over toes and make sure you push with the front foot not the back.

ss.note: This superset is great for adding mass to the legs that we would miss otherwise. DONT SKIP THESE

ex.note: I normally throw abs in where i can, and leg day is normally that day. Feel free to move this to other days or add it on to others. Just get in some ab work wherever possible!!!
You might be fatigued from RDLs on these but focus on your form. Make sure you get some scapular movement and a nice stretch. Dont be afraid to horse the weight around, just dont flail around.

Cable or dumbbell.
Really focus on the stretch here yet again. I like to even lean into the arm I'm pulling with to get MORE stretch. Let the weight pull ur shoulders forward, brace your core and PULL
Unlike on push day #1, this is not for a warm up. Make these as hard as possible while keeping form consistent. Pull high to the forehead for more delts, low to the chin for more upper back.
Keep the form cleaner on here at the start but have some fun towards the end. Keep palms facing up the whole movement.
These are gonna be hard, esp at the end of the workout. I love an EZ bar here but if you'd rather use DB feel free. Start light and work up. the burn will kill u here LOL

ex.note: Start lower than you think on these. If not weighted then do body weight, with a band if needed. The hardest part is the first pull up!!! (use straps if needed as you add more weight)
SPAM THESE, i put 4 sets but you can do more if desired. You're training a small group of upper back muscles here, they can recover fast. PUSH THESE HARD
Adjust seat so that the support is hitting just below your pec, this will allow the most scapular movement as possible. Let the weight pull your shoulders forward at the bottom. Use straps
Take these to failure!! First bicep isolation of the week, use that to put max effort in on these.
Start light with these and add weight later in the program. Really focusing on the lengthened/bottom position here. Can go past failure with lengthened partials but save till later in the program!
After Warm ups hit these harder than you think. 6-8 reps should be hard and heavy. Last two sets are there for skill work.
Keeping it lighter this day, later in the week we'll go heavier. Brace your core and push hips back, straps can help remove focus from grip.
We're doing these for our quads today, so keep feet closer together and low on the pad. Control the lowering on these.
These dont need much queing, just take them hard and lean forward for more stretch.

ss.note: Super set these with bodyweight sissy squats, i normally use the machine as a support.

ex.note: Use these similarly to the face pulls on the first push day, a glorified warm up. I use 15 lbs so start pretty light.
Now is the time to push these hard, load up the belt, put on the bumping tunes and bust out some heavy reps here. Warm up with a set of bodyweight here.
I prefer standing barbell over seated dumbell, whichever you feel more comfy taking to failure do.
Really Focus on feeling this in your triceps, your shoulders and chest should be rather fatigued already.

ss.note: These are one of my fav triceps builders! Keep elbows behind head, you can flare out if its more comfy for you or you can keep them forward.
This is something ive just started using and ive been loving it. Really focus on the bottom here, go heavier than normal and bust out partials.

ex.note: Take these as hard as possible; we limited lower back on the previous pull day just for these, make it count.
This will be our biggest quad movement today so push them hard and to failure. Feet close and low on pad. I want your calves touching your hamstrings. GET LOWER
Do these weighted with straps so your grip isn't a limiting factor. Knees over toes and make sure you push with the front foot not the back.

ss.note: This superset is great for adding mass to the legs that we would miss otherwise. DONT SKIP THESE

ex.note: I normally throw abs in where i can, and leg day is normally that day. Feel free to move this to other days or add it on to others. Just get in some ab work wherever possible!!!
You might be fatigued from RDLs on these but focus on your form. Make sure you get some scapular movement and a nice stretch. Dont be afraid to horse the weight around, just dont flail around.

Cable or dumbbell.
Really focus on the stretch here yet again. I like to even lean into the arm I'm pulling with to get MORE stretch. Let the weight pull ur shoulders forward, brace your core and PULL
Unlike on push day #1, this is not for a warm up. Make these as hard as possible while keeping form consistent. Pull high to the forehead for more delts, low to the chin for more upper back.
Keep the form cleaner on here at the start but have some fun towards the end. Keep palms facing up the whole movement.
These are gonna be hard, esp at the end of the workout. I love an EZ bar here but if you'd rather use DB feel free. Start light and work up. the burn will kill u here LOL
Using these as some preventative maintenance for shoulder health. Use the time between sets to also warm up with bands etc.
